name: project
title: New React Project
description: Creates a React project from the project scaffold with a minimal or style-guide starter, optional database example and optional UI kit.

settings.name: folder
settings.title: Parent Folder
settings.description: Folder that will contain the project.

settings.name: add_database
settings.title: Include SQLite Demo
settings.description: Local seed database and inspection script only; does not deploy an API.

settings.name: add_ui_kit
settings.title: Add UI Kit
settings.description: Run the React UI-kit seed, then finalize temporary UI-kit markers.

settings.name: custom_toolkit_path
settings.title: Custom Toolkit Path
settings.description: Optional absolute toolkit folder. Defaults to this tool's toolkit; an empty string leaves the new project without a custom toolkit.
